name: Oregano

low.description: About 1 teaspoon dried or 1 tablespoon fresh

siboNotes: Oregano is naturally FODMAP-free and safe for SIBO diets. Its antimicrobial properties may even support digestive health.
preparationTips: Add dried oregano at the end of cooking to preserve flavor
Fresh oregano is best added in the last few minutes of cooking
Store dried oregano in airtight container away from light
Crush dried oregano between fingers before adding to release oils
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of iron and manganese
